currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only;no bespoke survey sources or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected elevated northwest view: broad rounded lower sandstone body with repeated pilasters/tall windows, low brown-gray hipped aisle roof, pale metal apron around narrower rounded upper nave, dark hipped nave roof, two balustrade tiers with selected stone figures, single open staged tower with green onion/spire. Adjacent castle roofs, castle tower and covered connection remain outside this cathedral model.

Inspected opposite elevated side/front: one tall slender tower with stacked open bays/columns, small curved crown stage and green onion/spike/cross; rounded upper nave has tall windows below oval upper lights, repeated pilasters, dark roof and statue/balustrade line. Main entrance in tower base, lower rounded body and another statue line. Exact sculptures and black weathering stains are not reproduced.
